raw_posts.name: Mycel
raw_posts.tagline: Bring one past deliverable. Mycel drafts every future one.
raw_posts.description: Mycel runs the work your service business sells - clients, deliverables, approvals, invoices. Each job runs in a disposable sandbox that never holds a credential, and nothing reaches a client until you approve it. From $299/mo, or self-host free.

raw_posts.name: Minicart
raw_posts.tagline: Launch your store. Let AI run the busywork.
raw_posts.description: Minicart helps makers, creators, and resellers launch and run an online store without learning ecommerce software. Minicart gives you a store and an AI team to help run it. Sloane manages your storefront, Milo creates marketing, and Logan handles logistics and customer replies. Add products, update inventory, create promotions, ship orders, and more by simply chatting with your team. Just tell your team what you need in plain language, review their work, and keep building your business.

raw_posts.name: Morsa Signals
raw_posts.tagline: GTM and AI visibility workflows for developer tools

Each workflow starts from your actual product and produces a focused, actionable result instead of a generic report or database.
